After exhausting every means of killing and annihilating one another, their struggle drew to a close with the disappearance of the knight in red.

ならば、時間さえかしいでいると言えるだろう。

pages.en:
The hall that once flaunted its splendor has been transformed.

The floor is fractured into countless pieces.

The walls have been pierced through layer after layer.

The stairs have collapsed, and shattered marble scatters like gravel on the wind.

The space has been destroyed beyond recognition. Nothing remains of the hall as it was.

One might say that even time has been bent here: the devastation will not permit anyone to remember how this place looked a mere two hours ago.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The gorgeous hall is completely transformed.
The floor is cracked in numerous places.
Many walls have been knocked down.
The stairs have collapsed and the smashed marble has scattered in the wind.
The space has been completely destroyed, leaving no trace of its former beauty.
You could say it has also destroyed time.
Because the remains of the destruction hide what the place looked like just two hours ago.

pages.en:
One: both legs are on the verge of collapse.

Two: the wound of a severing circles his neck.

Three: his arms remain attached only at the elbows.

Four: he has been pierced from shoulder to groin.

Five: blood pours from his chest.

Six: a hollow has been gouged through his abdomen.

Berserker does not move.

Naturally.

By every appearance, he is a corpse.

The battle itself was settled in roughly an hour.

But the outcome was so utterly unexpected that Berserker's Master forgot herself.

She should already have gone to hunt her prey. Instead, she stands transfixed, staring at the devastation.
pages.mirrorMoon:

But Berserker’s Master has forgotten to act as this result is too surprising and unexpected.
She has to pursue her prey, but she is only looking at this scene in astonishment.

Her Servant is the strongest.

Among the countless Heroic Spirits, perhaps only one or two could stand against Heracles, whose name is among the most renowned of all.

Yet an Archer of unknown identity—a hero from no legend she could name—defeated him.

The knight in red fought Berserker on equal terms and achieved what no one ever had before: he killed Berserker.

But Archer, a heroic spirit of unknown identity, has defeated him.
